```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

real_beta_vector <- function(dimention,
                             zeta,
                             r,
                             pseudo_size = 1000) {
  # generate real beta vector shown in paper

  real_beta0 <- c(rep(0, dimention))

  # ζ zeta proportion of the coordinates of β(0) is randomly selected and set to 1
  real_beta0[sample(dimention, (dimention) * zeta, replace = FALSE)] <- 1
  real_beta0 <- c(0, rnorm(dimention) * real_beta0)
  pseudo_covariate <- observed_covariate_vector(dimention, pseudo_size, 0, diag(rep(1, dimention)), 0.5)
  beta_scale <- 1

  repeat {
    real_beta <- real_beta0 * beta_scale
    real_beta[1] <- -mean(pseudo_covariate %*% real_beta[-1])
    pseudo_response <- fam_mean("binomial")(pseudo_covariate, real_beta)
    oracle_error <- mean(1 - abs(1 - 2 * pseudo_response)) / 2
    if (abs(oracle_error - r) < 0.005) {
      break
    }
    beta_scale <- ifelse(oracle_error > r, beta_scale * 1.1, beta_scale * 0.9)
  }
  return(real_beta)
}

observed_covariate_vector <- function(dimention, # number of columns
                                      sample_size, # number of rows
                                      Z_mean,
                                      Z_variance,
                                      Z_corr) {
  # generate observed covariate vector from Gaussian random vector Z

  X_i <- Z_i <- MASS::mvrnorm(
    n = sample_size,
    mu = rep(Z_mean, dimention),
    Sigma = correlation_matrix(Z_corr, dimention) %*% Z_variance
  )


  # set Xi,j = 2 · 1Zi,j >0 − 1, 2j < p Zi,j , 2j ≥ p
  X_i[, 1:floor(dimention / 2)] <- 2 * (Z_i[, 1:floor(dimention / 2)] > 0) - 1

  return(X_i)
}
```

# Introduction

This is one other __catalytic__ vignettes go into the particularities of example of logistic regression from paper.

```{r data, eval=TRUE}
library(catalytic)
sample_size <- 20 # observed data sample size
dimention <- 5 # number of covariate

Z_corr <- 0.5
Z_mean <- 0
Z_variance <- 1

zeta <- 0.75
r <- 0.1

observed_covariate <- as.data.frame(observed_covariate_vector(
  dimention,
  sample_size,
  Z_mean,
  diag(rep(Z_variance, dimention)),
  Z_corr
))

real_beta <- real_beta_vector(dimention, zeta, r)

observed_response <- data.frame(y = generate_data_from_dist(
  "binomial",
  nrow(observed_covariate),
  fam_mean("binomial")(observed_covariate, real_beta)
))

obs_data <- cbind(observed_covariate, observed_response)

head(obs_data)

real_beta
```

Let's see how is works in glm.

```{r glm}
stats::glm(y ~ ., family = binomial, data = obs_data)
```

Let's do a simple test on them.

```{r}
err <- function(x,
                beta0,
                beta1) {
  return(mean(discrepancy_functions("logarithmic")(fam_mean("binomial")(x, beta0), fam_mean("binomial")(x, beta1))))
}

sample_size <- 80 # observed data sample size CHANGE
dimention <- 20 # number of covariate CHNAGE

Z_corr <- 0.5
Z_mean <- 0
Z_variance <- 1

z <- 0.75 # nonsparsity
r <- 0.1 # oracle classification error
init_taus <- seq(1, 100, 5) # CHANGE
simulation_times <- 5 # CHANGE

glm_results <-
  freq_boots_results <-
  freq_stein_results <-
  freq_cv_results <-
  bayes_tau_001_52_results <-
  bayes_tau_005_52_results <-
  bayes_tau_005_73_results <-
  bayes_tau_01_52_results <-
  bayes_tau_01_73_results <-
  bayes_theta_2_52_results <-
  bayes_theta_21_52_results <-
  bayes_theta_21_73_results <-
  bayes_theta_25_52_results <-
  bayes_theta_25_73_results <-
  bayes_theta_3_52_results <-
  bayes_theta_3_73_results <-
  bayes_gibb_2000_54_results <-
  bayes_gibb_5000_54_results <-
  bayes_gibb_8000_54_results <-
  c()

for (t in (1:simulation_times)) {
  set.seed(t)
  cat("\nsimulation times:", t)

  observed_covariate <- observed_covariate_vector(
    dimention,
    sample_size,
    Z_mean,
    diag(rep(Z_variance, dimention)),
    Z_corr
  )

  real_beta <- real_beta_vector(dimention, z, r)

  observed_response <- data.frame(y = generate_data_from_dist(
    "binomial",
    nrow(observed_covariate),
    fam_mean("binomial")(observed_covariate, real_beta)
  ))

  obs_data <- cbind(observed_covariate, observed_response)

  data_ <- initialization(y ~ 1, family = binomial(), data = obs_data)

  glm_beta <- stats::glm(y ~ ., family = binomial(), data = obs_data)$coefficients

  freq_boots_beta <- cat_freq_glm(y ~ .,
    family = binomial(),
    data_ = data_,
    risk_estimate_method = "parametric_bootstrap",
    discrepancy_function = "logistic_deviance",
    taus = init_taus
  )$beta

  freq_stein_beta <- cat_freq_glm(y ~ .,
    family = binomial(),
    data_ = data_,
    risk_estimate_method = "steinian_estimate",
    discrepancy_function = "logistic_deviance",
    taus = init_taus
  )$beta

  freq_cv_beta <- cat_freq_glm(y ~ .,
    family = binomial(),
    data_ = data_,
    risk_estimate_method = "cross_validation",
    discrepancy_function = "logistic_deviance",
    taus = init_taus,
    cv_fold_num = 10
  )$beta


  bayes_tau_001_52_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(
    y ~ .,
    family = binomial,
    data_ = data_,
    joint = TRUE,
    iter = 5000,
    warmup = 2000,
    lower = 0.01
  )
  bayes_tau_001_52_beta <- as.numeric(head(rstan::summary(bayes_tau_001_52_model$sample_model)$summary[, "mean"][-1], -1))

  bayes_tau_005_52_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(
    y ~ .,
    family = binomial,
    data_ = data_,
    joint = TRUE,
    iter = 5000,
    warmup = 2000,
    lower = 0.05
  )
  bayes_tau_005_52_beta <- as.numeric(head(rstan::summary(bayes_tau_005_52_model$sample_model)$summary[, "mean"][-1], -1))


  bayes_tau_005_73_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(
    y ~ .,
    family = binomial,
    data_ = data_,
    joint = TRUE,
    iter = 7000,
    warmup = 3000,
    lower = 0.05
  )
  bayes_tau_005_73_beta <- as.numeric(head(rstan::summary(bayes_tau_005_73_model$sample_model)$summary[, "mean"][-1], -1))


  bayes_tau_01_52_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(
    y ~ .,

    lower = 0.1
  )
  bayes_tau_01_52_beta <- as.numeric(head(rstan::summary(bayes_tau_01_52_model$sample_model)$summary[, "mean"][-1], -1))

  bayes_tau_01_73_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(
    y ~ .,
    family = binomial,
    data_ = data_,
    joint = TRUE,
    iter = 7000,
    warmup = 3000,
    lower = 0.1
  )
  bayes_tau_01_73_beta <- as.numeric(head(rstan::summary(bayes_tau_01_73_model$sample_model)$summary[, "mean"][-1], -1))


  bayes_theta_2_52_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(
    y ~ .,
    family = binomial,
    data_ = data_,
    use_theta = TRUE,
    joint = TRUE,
    iter = 5000,
    warmup = 2000,
    joint_alpha = 2
  )
  bayes_theta_2_52_beta <- as.numeric(head(rstan::summary(bayes_theta_2_52_model$sample_model)$summary[, "mean"][-1], -1))

  bayes_theta_21_52_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(
    y ~ .,
    family = binomial,
    data_ = data_,
    use_theta = TRUE,
    joint = TRUE,
    iter = 5000,
    warmup = 2000,
    joint_alpha = 2.1
  )
  bayes_theta_21_52_beta <- as.numeric(head(rstan::summary(bayes_theta_21_52_model$sample_model)$summary[, "mean"][-1], -1))

  bayes_theta_21_73_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(
    y ~ .,
    family = binomial,
    data_ = data_,
    use_theta = TRUE,
    joint = TRUE,
    iter = 7000,
    warmup = 3000,
    joint_alpha = 2.1
  )
  bayes_theta_21_73_beta <- as.numeric(head(rstan::summary(bayes_theta_21_73_model$sample_model)$summary[, "mean"][-1], -1))


  bayes_theta_25_52_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(
    y ~ .,
    family = binomial,
    data_ = data_,
    use_theta = TRUE,
    joint = TRUE,
    iter = 5000,
    warmup = 2000,
    joint_alpha = 2.5
  )
  bayes_theta_25_52_beta <- as.numeric(head(rstan::summary(bayes_theta_25_52_model$sample_model)$summary[, "mean"][-1], -1))

  bayes_theta_25_73_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(
    y ~ .,
    family = binomial,
    data_ = data_,
    use_theta = TRUE,
    joint = TRUE,
    iter = 7000,
    warmup = 3000,
    joint_alpha = 2.5
  )
  bayes_theta_25_73_beta <- as.numeric(head(rstan::summary(bayes_theta_25_73_model$sample_model)$summary[, "mean"][-1], -1))

  bayes_theta_3_52_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(
    y ~ .,
    family = binomial,
    data_ = data_,
    use_theta = TRUE,
    joint = TRUE,
    iter = 5000,
    warmup = 2000,
    joint_alpha = 3
  )
  bayes_theta_3_52_beta <- as.numeric(head(rstan::summary(bayes_theta_3_52_model$sample_model)$summary[, "mean"][-1], -1))

  bayes_theta_3_73_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(

    joint_alpha = 3
  )
  bayes_theta_3_73_beta <- as.numeric(head(rstan::summary(bayes_theta_3_73_model$sample_model)$summary[, "mean"][-1], -1))


  bayes_gibb_2000_54_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(
    y ~ .,
    family = binomial,
    data_ = data_,
    joint = TRUE,
    gibbs = TRUE,
    gibbs_iter = 2000,
    chains = 1,
    warmup = 4,
    iter = 5
  ) # CHANGE
  bayes_gibb_2000_54_beta <- bayes_gibb_2000_54_model$beta


  bayes_gibb_5000_54_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(
    y ~ .,
    family = binomial,
    data_ = data_,
    joint = TRUE,
    gibbs = TRUE,
    gibbs_iter = 5000,
    chains = 1,
    warmup = 4,
    iter = 5
  ) # CHANGE
  bayes_gibb_5000_54_beta <- bayes_gibb_5000_54_model$beta


  bayes_gibb_8000_54_model <- cat_bayesian_glm(
    y ~ .,
    family = binomial,
    data_ = data_,
    joint = TRUE,
    gibbs = TRUE,
    gibbs_iter = 8000,
    chains = 1,
    warmup = 4,
    iter = 5
  ) # CHANGE
  bayes_gibb_8000_54_beta <-
    bayes_gibb_8000_54_model$beta



  test_x <- observed_covariate_vector(

  )

  glm_results <- append(

  freq_boots_results <- append(
```

```{r result}
# Define the list of methods
methods <- c(
  "glm", "freq_boots", "freq_stein", "freq_cv",
  "bayes_tau_001_52_beta", "bayes_tau_005_52_beta",
  "bayes_tau_005_73_beta", "bayes_tau_01_52_beta",
  "bayes_tau_01_73_beta", "bayes_theta_2_52_beta",
  "bayes_theta_21_52_beta", "bayes_theta_21_73_beta",
  "bayes_theta_25_52_beta", "bayes_theta_25_73_beta",
  "bayes_theta_3_52_beta", "bayes_theta_3_73_beta",
  "bayes_gibb_2000_54_beta", "bayes_gibb_5000_54_beta",
  "bayes_gibb_8000_54_beta"
)

# Remove "_beta" from the method names
methods <- gsub("_beta", "", methods)

# Define the list of results
results_list <- list(
  glm_results, freq_boots_results, freq_stein_results, freq_cv_results,
  bayes_tau_001_52_results, bayes_tau_005_52_results,
  bayes_tau_005_73_results, bayes_tau_01_52_results,
  bayes_tau_01_73_results, bayes_theta_2_52_results,
  bayes_theta_21_52_results, bayes_theta_21_73_results,
  bayes_theta_25_52_results, bayes_theta_25_73_results,
  bayes_theta_3_52_results, bayes_theta_3_73_results,
  bayes_gibb_2000_54_results, bayes_gibb_5000_54_results,
  bayes_gibb_8000_54_results
)

# Calculate mean and standard error for each method
means <- sapply(results_list, mean)
ses <- sapply(results_list, function(x) sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)))

# Create the dataframe
results <- data.frame(Method = methods, Mean = means, SE = ses)
```
